# incorrect outline is added

Fix a name collision in the Brewfile: the `outline` cask on Homebrew is [Outline](https://outline.app), a note-taking app, whereas the author wanted the Outline VPN client from [getoutline.org](https://getoutline.org) (Jigsaw's Shadowsocks-based VPN). The earlier tickets [#215](DOT-214.md) and [#261](DOT-260.md) had added the wrong one.
